description: Supported by reports of cross-specialist coordination, scheduling around work, medication/log-in workbooks, access barriers, remote administrative coordination, and an explicit request for a care-information-sharing app.
job_to_be_done: When coordinating an aging parent's care, help me maintain an accurate shared view of medical tasks and information so follow-ups do not fail.
notes: FACT: linked observations. Triangulation 2026-09-07: source diversity improved from Reddit-only to Reddit, caregiver forums, public Q&A, and search-result supporting evidence. Contradiction: a family reported that a Google spreadsheet and LastPass were helpful; portals, authorization, and existing tools may adequately solve some cases. Previous confidence: 72.
problem_statement: Adult children coordinating an aging parent's healthcare lack a reliable way to keep appointments, medications, records, and provider communication aligned.

description: Supported by past-due bills, bill lists, auto-pay, account access, missed deadlines, requests for a guide, and an independent case of late bills and missed Medicare drug coverage with out-of-pocket cost.
job_to_be_done: When I take on a parent's administration, help me identify, organize, and complete time-sensitive tasks without reconstructing everything manually.
notes: FACT: linked observations. Triangulation 2026-09-07 added an independent caregiver-forum case with concrete financial and medication consequences. Existing workarounds include lists, portals, and autopay; their effectiveness across families is untested. Previous confidence: 74.
problem_statement: Adult children inherit fragmented administrative work when an aging parent cannot reliably manage bills, mail, accounts, appointments, and deadlines.

description: Supported by local caregivers carrying appointments, shopping, emergencies, and updates while siblings do not participate or criticize, plus an independent caregiver-forum account of three years of solo task ownership and a need for a break.
job_to_be_done: When my family shares parent-care responsibilities, help us make ownership and updates visible without repeated conflict or one person absorbing the load.
notes: FACT: linked observations. Triangulation 2026-09-07 improved independent support beyond Reddit. A search-result signal supports solution discovery only. Contradiction: no direct evidence yet that a shared tool repairs family conflict; frequency and willingness to use shared systems remain unknown. Previous confidence: 66.
problem_statement: Families coordinating aging-parent care struggle to distribute work and maintain constructive communication when one relative carries most responsibilities.

description: Supported by caregiver burnout, paid-coverage trade-offs, unpaid care crowding out work, medication-reminder burden, multiple payment-structure inquiries, one reported family-funded caregiver arrangement, and work constraint from caregiving tasks.
job_to_be_done: When care needs exceed my capacity, help me understand and coordinate the next practical care arrangement without carrying every task alone.
notes: FACT: linked observations. Triangulation 2026-09-07 added multiple independent payment-related inquiries and one current paid family-care arrangement. Contradiction: one household had a long-term-care policy and could afford assisted living, so affordability and unmet need are not universal. Previous confidence: 64.
problem_statement: Adult children face difficult care-capacity decisions when unpaid family work and paid caregiving needs exceed available time, money, or stamina.
